text: The US Treasury designated the Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation in December 2020 for being owned or controlled by Ramzan Kadyrov, the head of the Chechen Republic.
short: US Treasury: the Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation is owned or controlled by Chechen head Ramzan Kadyrov

source.name: US Department of the Treasury: Treasury Sanctions Serious Human Rights Abusers on International Human Rights Day
source.quote: Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation for being owned or controlled by Kadyrov.

additionalSources.name: Meduza: U.S. imposes sanctions on Kadyrov's foundation and soccer club over rights violations in Chechnya
additionalSources.quote: Among the organizations added to the sanctions list are the soccer club FC Akhmat Grozny and the Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation
